reading.body:
Google operates a confirmed data center in Henderson, Nevada at 540 West Warm Springs Road. The facility's power capacity is not published. Google's disclosure policy limits public information on individual facilities to aggregate state-level investment figures, so the specific megawatt capacity, square footage, and detailed specifications of this campus are not available from the operator.

Nevada has 26 mapped data center facilities, of which only two publish power capacity figures. This Henderson site ranks third among Nevada facilities by published megawatt capacity, though that ranking reflects the scarcity of published data rather than a complete ranking of all sites in the state. The two facilities with published figures account for 10.37 MW total in Nevada, but this sum excludes the vast majority of mapped capacity whose operators do not disclose figures.

Whether this campus matters to AI scaling cannot be assessed from published specifications. The absence of disclosed power capacity means the site cannot be placed within national or global data center rankings. To evaluate its significance to AI compute availability and grid strain, direct disclosure from Google or regulatory filings with capacity figures would be required.
